title: Dialer Mute Delay on PII Capture Remediation
issue_summary: Automated audio mute delay of 1.2s observed during credit card expiration date capture on voice calls.
root_cause: Dialer pause-recording webhook latency on legacy SIP trunk routing during peak volume hours.
corrective_action: Deploy low-latency edge mute trigger microservice and upgrade agent softphone client build to v4.2.1.
preventive_action: Implement synthetic automated test calls daily to monitor mute latency and alarm if delay > 100ms.
evidence_notes: Edge service deployed in staging. Load testing indicates latency dropped to 45ms.

history.note: Issue identified during QA audio sampling.
Assigned to Lead Systems Architect Harpreet Singh.

title: Floor Workstation Auto-Lock Timeout Standardization
issue_summary: Screen lock timeout on 3 training pod stations was set to 600s instead of mandated 180s.
root_cause: Group Policy Object (GPO) replication delay to subnet 192.168.14.0/24 during branch domain controller sync.
corrective_action: Forced Active Directory GPUpdate across all operational subnets and added policy verification script.
preventive_action: Automated nightly audit script that scans domain endpoints and reports non-compliant lock timeouts.
evidence_notes: All 120 endpoints verified at 180s timeout. Signed off by Thinkatic Security Auditor.

history.note: GPO logs and endpoint scans submitted.
